# dbterm

> Keyboard-first terminal database workbench and native backup agent for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Turso and Cloudflare D1.

dbterm is created and maintained by Shreyam Adhikari (`shreyam1008`). It is an MIT-licensed Go project distributed as a cross-platform binary.

## Scope boundary

Backup supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Turso and Cloudflare D1. Restore currently supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB and local SQLite. dbterm includes a local STDIO MCP server with read-only database tools; it does not expose a hosted API, OAuth service, remote MCP endpoint or autonomous agent endpoint.
